info.name: Rokn API - Full Collection
info.description: Complete API endpoints for the Rokn educational platform: authentication, courses, certificates, levels, grades, paths, notifications, and more.

item.name: Authentication
item.description: User registration, login, phone verification, and password management.

request.description: Register a new user. A verification code is sent via WhatsApp.
Resend verification code via WhatsApp.
Verify phone with the code received via WhatsApp.
Login with phone and password. Phone must be verified first.
Login via social provider (google, facebook, apple).
Request password reset code via WhatsApp.
Reset password with verification code.
Logout the authenticated user.
Permanently delete the authenticated user's account.

item.name: Course Discovery
item.description: Public course catalogue and app settings.

request.description: Returns the paginated public course catalogue used by the app home screen.
Returns platform name, social media links, support contacts, and app store URLs.
Check if the app version is still supported. platform: android or ios.

item.name: Courses
item.description: Course listing, details, progress tracking, and section completion.

query.description: Filter by type: online, center, both (optional)

request.description: Returns paginated list of courses. Each course includes is_coming_soon flag. Supports filtering by grade, course_type, and search query.
Returns paginated courses using BaseCourseResource. Includes is_coming_soon flag for each course.
Get full course details. If enrolled: returns full CourseResource with locked section status and video URLs. If not enrolled: returns BaseCourseResource preview. Includes is_coming_soon flag.
Legacy endpoint. Returns BaseCourseResource or CourseResource based on enrollment.
Get current user's progress in a course. Returns total/completed sections, percentage, and lock status per section. Requires enrollment.
Mark a course section as completed. Returns updated section info and overall course progress. Fires CourseCompleted event if all sections are done (triggers certificate generation).
Get top-performing students in a course (public endpoint).
Submit or update a course rating (1-5 stars). Requires enrollment.
Get all project evaluations for the current user in a specific course.

item.name: Course Authorization & Enrollment
item.description: Purchase courses with coins, check access, and view billing history.

request.description: Get all active payment methods available for course purchase.
Purchase course access using wallet coins. Deducts coins, creates order, bill, and enrollment. payment_method: wallet | online | course_code.
Check if the current user has direct or parent-course access to a course. Returns has_access, access_type (direct|parent), and enrollment details.
List all active course enrollments for the current user with per-course progress percentage.
Get all course purchase orders for the current user with pagination.
Get billing history for the current user with payment status and bill numbers.

item.name: Course Codes
item.description: Redeem and manage course access codes.

request.description: Redeem a course access code to enroll in a course.
Validate a course code before redeeming it.
List all course codes redeemed by the current user.

item.name: Course PDFs
item.description: Secure PDF access for enrolled students.

request.description: List all active PDFs for a course. Requires enrollment.
Get details for a specific PDF. Requires enrollment.
Stream/download a PDF securely. Requires enrollment. No direct file URL exposed.

item.name: Certificates
item.description: View earned certificates after completing courses.

request.description: List all certificates earned by the current user. Returns certificate_number, issue_date, course title, and download info.
Get certificate for a specific course. Returns 404 if certificate not yet earned, 403 if not enrolled.

item.name: Grades (Levels)
item.description: Grade/academic year levels used to categorize and filter courses.

request.description: List all active grades ordered by sort order. Returns id, name_ar, name_en, description, and courses_count.
Get a specific grade with all its associated courses.
Get all courses belonging to a specific grade.

item.name: Paths
item.description: Learning paths that group related courses into a structured journey.

request.description: List all learning paths. Returns id, title_ar, title_en, image, description, and course count.
Get a specific path with title_ar, title_en, interests, and associated courses.
Get paths relevant to the current user based on their selected interests.

item.name: Interests & Classifications
item.description: Browse and update user interest classifications.

request.description: List all available interest classifications (public).
Alias for interests. Returns all classifications with their course groups.
Set or update the current user's interests. Replaces all existing interests with the provided IDs.

item.name: Profile
item.description: View and update user profile information.

request.description: Get user profile: name, phone, email, wallet_coins, enrolled courses, interests, and level info.
Update profile fields. Changing phone requires re-verification.

item.name: Notifications
item.description: Student notification management.

request.description: Get the number of unread notifications. Used for the bell icon badge.
Get the 10 most recent notifications for the dropdown/bell icon.
Get all notifications for the current user (paginated).
Mark a specific notification as read. Replace 1 with notification ID.
Mark all notifications as read for the current user.

item.name: Saved Folders (Bookmarks)
item.description: Bookmark lessons into folders for later review.

request.description: List all bookmark folders for the current user.
Create a new bookmark folder.
Get the lessons saved in a specific folder.
Delete a folder and all its bookmarks.
Add a lesson to a saved folder.
Remove a specific lesson from a saved folder.

item.name: Portfolio
item.description: Manage user portfolio items (text, images, videos).

request.description: List all portfolio items for the authenticated user.
Create a new text-only portfolio item.
Create a portfolio item with an image or video file.
Get a specific portfolio item by ID.
Add additional media files to an existing portfolio item.
Remove a specific media file from a portfolio item.
Delete a portfolio item permanently.

item.name: Coin Earning Methods
item.description: Wallet coin earning mechanism.

request.description: List all active coin earning methods (e.g., register, complete course, daily login).
Claim coins for a specific earning method. Returns updated wallet balance.

item.name: Streaks
item.description: Daily learning streak tracking.

request.description: Get the current user's streak information (current streak days, longest streak, last active date).

item.name: Projects
item.description: Course project evaluation via AI.

request.description: Get project requirements, instructions, and AI model configuration.
Submit project answer for AI evaluation. Returns score (0-100) and passed boolean.

item.name: Packages & Payments
item.description: Coin packages and Kashier payment gateway integration.

request.description: List all available coin packages for purchase.
Get details of a specific coin package.
Initiate a Kashier payment for a package. Returns a checkout_url to open in a WebView.
Poll payment status by order reference after WebView returns. Returns order state.

item.name: Centers & Groups
item.description: Physical learning centers and student groups.

request.description: List all learning centers.
Get details of a specific center including address and contact info.
Get all student groups belonging to a specific center.

item.name: Attendance
item.description: QR code-based attendance recording for groups.

request.description: Get the QR code image for a user's attendance token. Replace 1 with user ID.
Get attendance records for a specific user.
Record attendance by scanning QR code token. Used by teacher devices.
